title: UAE Videos
summary: A series of social media videos created for Rabdan Developments to express solidarity with the UAE, appreciation for the country’s Armed Forces, and a sense of national unity during a significant period for the country.
description:
A series of social media videos created for Rabdan Developments to express solidarity with the UAE, appreciation for the country’s Armed Forces, and a sense of national unity during a significant period for the country.

The series included content around Eid, UAE Armed Forces Unification Day, and broader messages of support for the UAE, developed with a cinematic and respectful visual approach.

Across social media, the videos generated more than 1 million views, reflecting strong organic reach and audience engagement.
